traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet. This combination is modern/cyclic only.

modern.blend: Drive meets imagination. Energy steered by vision and a persuasive, magnetic pull.
modern.harmonious: Charismatic motivation; action aligned with imagination.
modern.hard: Misdirected effort: setting off one way and ending up another, with energy quietly draining away.
modern.business: Inspiring and persuasive; keep the aim concrete or the drive dissipates.
